description.value:
Frequency once per character level

Requirement Willing target with Resonance 1 or higher.

Perform a bio-augment's Walk-back 2 rite in a single action instead of a week of downtime.

You perform a Walk-back 2 rite — the same rite Wardbreaker's unbinding, the Choir of Ash's rite, or a Seed-Warden's Grove-Bind would otherwise take a week of downtime to complete — in a single action, right now, on a willing target. It reduces the target's Resonance by 1, exactly as the week-long version would. This still only works once per character level, same as the ordinary rite, and the two don't stack into two uses at the same level.

cinderfall.incomplete: Downtime time-compression ('perform a week-long rite in a single action instead') matches this pass's pre-confirmed finding that downtime time-adjustment is never rule-element-encoded in real pf2e. The actual Resonance-adjustment number belongs to whatever record defines the underlying 'Walk-back 2' rite, which is shared with the Choir of Ash archetype and a Seed-Warden feat and is not one of this class's own files -- out of scope to touch here.
